scope.basis: Methods, 'Timeline': "Participants were recruited between August 2022 and October 2023." 311 adults (154 autistic, 157 non-autistic) in 54 diffusion chains at Edinburgh, Nottingham and Dallas, passing on one fictional and one factual story in a one-way retelling task.

fidelity.basis: The authors' models, data and threshold. Ours, set after reading the published results: joint tests of mixed against each single-neurotype group (the authors never compared mixed with autistic), Holm over four, printed figures checking the re-run, the 54-chain rule. Not refuted means no difference detected. No Bayes factors. A one-way retelling task: not everyday conversation or double empathy.
